facts.text: It was the homeworld of the Kel Dors, with an atmosphere of a unique gas and helium.

evidence.quote: It was the homeworld of the Kel Dors, with an atmosphere of a unique gas and helium.

facts.text: Dorin was situated between two black holes, making access to the planet limited; any space travel for the natives was also highly dangerous, as Dorin's atmosphere contained very little oxygen, and barely supported life (although some flora did exist on the planet).

evidence.quote: Dorin was situated between two black holes, making access to the planet limited; any space travel for the natives was also highly dangerous, as Dorin's atmosphere contained very little oxygen, and barely supported life (although some flora did exist on the planet).

facts.text: The inhabitants had evolved to survive in an environment within which most other species would perish, being effectively void of oxygen, nitrogen, and carbon dioxide.

evidence.quote: The inhabitants had evolved to survive in an environment within which most other species would perish, being effectively void of oxygen, nitrogen, and carbon dioxide.

facts.text: This atmospheric composition affected the travel capabilities of the native Kel Dor, requiring them to wear antiox breath masks to filter out oxygen while off-world.

evidence.quote: This atmospheric composition affected the travel capabilities of the native Kel Dor, requiring them to wear antiox breath masks to filter out oxygen while off-world.

facts.text: Humans, however, could survive at least a short time in the atmosphere without suffering any ill effects; the exact length of time possible has not been measured.

evidence.quote: Humans, however, could survive at least a short time in the atmosphere without suffering any ill effects; the exact length of time possible has not been measured.

facts.text: Buildings on the planet's surface were constructed specifically to withstand violent storms and, in times of severe weather, most locations and homes were made available for anyone (Kel Dor or otherwise) to take shelter in.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, Dorin was a staunch supporter of the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, Dorin was a staunch supporter of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: It backed the formation of the Grand Army of the Republic, contributing a small number of defense troops and ships to the war effort.

facts.text: During the Imperial era, Dorin nominally fell under the authority of Moff Sticrie, who governed the sector from Myomar.

evidence.quote: During the Imperial era, Dorin nominally fell under the authority of Moff Sticrie, who governed the sector from Myomar.

facts.text: Dorin was located within space controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Hunt for Zsinj of 7–8 ABY and was within the core territory of Grand Admiral Thrawn's confederation during his campaign against the New Republic in 9 ABY.

evidence.quote: Dorin was located within space controlled by the Galactic Empire during the Hunt for Zsinj of 7–8 ABY and was within the core territory of Grand Admiral Thrawn's confederation during his campaign against the New Republic in 9 ABY.

facts.text: Dorin was outside of Imperial space by the following year, during which time it was attacked by Imperial forces, as part of an offensive by the reborn Emperor Palpatine's alliance of Imperial factions.

facts.text: The Sith then ordered that the best and brightest of the Kel Dor must offer their service to the Empire, or their people would suffer.

evidence.quote: The Sith then ordered that the best and brightest of the Kel Dor must offer their service to the Empire, or their people would suffer.

facts.text: As a result, many Kel Dor entered the Imperial service, though the blockade remained in place.
